messages:
alex.c: Heads up — noticed customers reporting mixed org rows in Insights for a handful of dashboards. Happens when switching org filter quickly. Screenshot attached. @priya any idea?
priya: thanks. I saw an alert from telemetry: some metric samples have org_id=null and are getting joined into the dashboard rollup. Maybe a telemetry ingestion edge case.
sam: reproducing now. Steps: org A -> open insights -> switch to org B fast -> some charts show values from org A for ~30s. Looks like query uses recent_metrics window without org scoping.
alex.c: can you paste the query that's running?
sam: paste: ```sql
select m.time_bucket, sum(value) from recent_metrics m join jobs j on m.job_id=j.id where j.team_id = $TEAM_ID group by time_bucket
```
priya: ah — join uses jobs.team_id but recent_metrics has team_id nullable for older batches. When null, join returns rows for any job_id which may map to other teams. We missed adding m.team_id in where.
jamie: so root cause is telemetry schema change + not preserving team_id in some ingesters. Also our canary for insights-v2 started yesterday and had relaxed sampling. That probably triggered.
infra-bot: Deploy 08:19:45 started for insights-service/canary-3 -> success
priya: short-term mitigation: add m.team_id = $TEAM_ID (explicit) in query and schedule a backfill for ingesters. Also add a regression test for null team_id.
alex.c: prioritize a hotfix: update query to include m.team_id = $TEAM_ID, rollback canary if we see >0.1% cross-team rows in last 1h. Who can PR?
sam: I can open PR in 10m. Will add unit test in analytics-infra and a regression in the e2e harness.
jamie: Also add an alert: count(recent_metrics where team_id IS NULL) > threshold -> page oncall. We should have had that.
alex.c: agreed. @infra-bot can we roll back canary to previous stable if PR not merged in 30m?
infra-bot: Rollback trigger requires manual approval. React with :thumbsup: to proceed.
priya: I'm +1 on PR now, will review immediately.
sam: PR opened: https://git/repo/pull/432 — fixes query and adds tests. Logged issue for ingestion backfill INC-3287.
alex.c: nice. After PR merges, schedule canary restart and monitor per-team leakage metric for 2 hours. Thanks everyone.
